title: Publish settings dialog and Test Movie preview
description: Implement Publish Settings dialog (File > Publish Settings): choose output filename, Flash version (lock to 8), ActionScript version (lock to AS2), JPEG quality, audio settings. Implement File > Publish: compile document to SWF using compileDocument(), trigger file download. Implement Control > Test Movie: compile document and open SWF in a new window/tab with an embedded Ruffle player for preview. Wire all three into the File/Control menu actions in Shell.tsx. See docs/15-file-formats-fla-swf.md.
